intro.h2: A working cabinet shop, not just a catalogue
paragraphs: T & A Cabinet Shop makes custom cabinets in Soddy-Daisy at its shop at 148 Bean St. Your cabinets go on the shop's work schedule, are built there and then go out to your house with an install crew.

A lot of its work is for people building a new home, so the team is used to working alongside a builder or general contractor. The showroom has sample cabinet runs, door samples and countertop samples, so you can compare wood, finish and hardware side by side before you order. A Google review describes prompt, courteous service from people who were very friendly.

about.text: T & A Cabinet Shop is a cabinet maker and cabinet store at 148 Bean St in Soddy-Daisy, Tennessee. The building holds both the shop where the cabinets are built and a showroom with sample cabinet runs, door samples and countertop displays. Most of the work customers describe on Google is cabinetry for houses being built: the team measures on site, builds in the shop and sends installers to fit the finished cabinets. The office keeps weekday hours, and you can reach it by phone at (423) 332-5635 or by email.

image.alt: T & A Cabinet Shop showroom on Bean Street with wood cabinet displays and countertop samples on a dark worktable

steps.title: Call or visit
steps.text: Call (423) 332-5635, email the shop, or stop by 148 Bean St on a weekday to talk about your kitchen.

steps.title: Measure
steps.text: The team comes out to your house or job site to measure the space for your cabinets.

steps.title: Choose your finish
steps.text: Pick the door style, wood, stain or paint and the hardware in the showroom, and look at the countertop samples.

steps.title: Build in the shop
steps.text: Your cabinets go on the shop work schedule and are built in Soddy-Daisy. Ask the office for the current schedule.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: Installers bring the finished cabinets to your home and fit them, working alongside your builder on new construction.

service_area.h2: Custom cabinets in Soddy-Daisy and nearby
service_area.text: T & A Cabinet Shop works from 148 Bean St in Soddy-Daisy, Tennessee. Homeowners and builders putting up new houses in and around Soddy-Daisy bring their plans to the showroom, and the team travels out to measure and install. If you are not sure whether your job site is in range, call (423) 332-5635 during weekday hours and ask the office.

items.q: Where is T & A Cabinet Shop?
items.a: The shop and showroom are at 148 Bean St, Soddy-Daisy, TN 37379. You can visit during opening hours to look at cabinet displays, door samples and countertop samples, and to talk with the office about a new kitchen or a house you are building.

Monday 9 AM to 3 PM, Tuesday through Thursday 9 AM to 4 PM, and Friday 9 AM to 3 PM. The shop is closed on Saturday and Sunday. Outside those hours, you can email tacabinets@comcast.net with your question or plans and include the best number to call you back.

items.q: Do you build the cabinets yourselves?
items.a: Yes. Cabinet orders are put on the shop work schedule and built at the Bean Street shop in Soddy-Daisy, then delivered and installed by the T & A install crew. Ask the office where your order sits on the current schedule when you place it.

items.q: Do you work with builders on new homes?
items.a: Yes. Many of the customers who have reviewed T & A were building a new house, and the shop worked alongside their builder or general contractor. The team measures on site, builds the cabinets in the shop and installs them as the house comes together.

items.q: How do I get a price for cabinets?
items.a: Call (423) 332-5635 or email tacabinets@comcast.net with your plans or rough measurements, or bring them to the showroom on a weekday. Ask about having the team come out to measure, so the price is based on your actual kitchen and layout.

final_cta.h2: Planning a kitchen or a new home?
final_cta.text: Talk to the Soddy-Daisy shop that builds the cabinets.
